title: Building a Sovereign Benchmark The Limits of Private Coordination
abstract: arXiv:2610.19516v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Public debt supplies liquidity and collateral services only if institutions coordinate on using the same claim. We study this coordination when use carries a recurring cost and a benefit that rises with other users. Above a quality threshold, two positive-adoption equilibria exist, and under best responses the initial user base decides between collapse and high adoption. Under logit choice, as the population grows and noise vanishes, the long-run distribution selects high adoption only above a strictly higher threshold. Debt issuance improves market depth but eventually dilutes backing per claim. This trade-off creates a range of debt levels supporting the liquidity premium of public debt in macroeconomic models and a narrower range supporting its long-run selection. translated_title: 构建主权基准：私人协调的局限
translated_abstract: 只有当各机构协调使用同一债权时，公共债务才能提供流动性和抵押品服务。我们研究了这种协调问题：使用该债权会产生经常性成本，而其收益随其他使用者数量的增加而上升（网络效应）。在质量阈值之上，存在两个正采用均衡；在最优反应动态下，初始使用者规模决定了协调走向崩溃还是高采用。在对数线性（logit）选择动态下，随着人口增长和噪声消失，长期分布只在严格更高的阈值之上才会选择高采用。债务发行会改善市场深度，但最终会稀释每一单位债权的担保支撑。这一权衡产生了一个支持宏观经济模型中公共债务流动性溢价的债务水平区间，以及一个更窄的、支持其长期选择所要求的区间。在较宽区间的边界处，流动性溢价是不连续的。而一项纠正采用外部性的匹配转移支付可以使稳态选择实现网络剩余最大化。
tldr: 本文研究公共债务作为主权基准资产时的私人协调问题，发现债务发行虽然能改善市场深度，但会稀释担保支撑，因此流动性溢价只存在于一个有限的债务水平区间内，且私人协调下的长期采用需要比静态均衡更高的质量阈值。
en_tdlr: This paper studies private coordination on a sovereign benchmark asset, showing that debt issuance improves market depth but dilutes backing, so the liquidity premium of public debt survives only within a bounded range of debt levels, while long-run selection under noisy dynamics requires a strictly higher quality threshold.
